_comment: Tag library seed. Phase 1 stand-in for GHL tag sync — Phase 2 replaces by_org with a `await blinkerApi.tags.list({ org_id })` call returning the same shape. system_tags are read-only across all orgs (Blinker-managed taxonomy); by_org are user-created tags that round-trip through GHL.
_source: Curated for Phase 1 prototype. Real GHL tag inventory pulls from each org's GHL location once the sync is wired (per architecture/07-data-layer.md).
_principle: Tag permissions are role-gated (canon/personas.json): any org role can `add_tags` (apply an existing tag to a contact); only manager+ roles can `create_tags` (mint a new tag). Agents must search-existing-only. The split prevents the GHL tag namespace from sprawling under agent activity. Tags belong on Contacts (per canon/blinker-domain.json `tag` block) — opportunity-scoped tags do not exist; tag the contact instead.

_shape.id: string — stable identifier (slug-form for system tags, uuid for user tags).
_shape.name: string — display label. Free-form for user tags; canonical for system tags.
_shape.color: string — hex color (#RRGGBB) for tag pill rendering. System tags carry a curated palette; user tags inherit GHL-stored hex.
_shape.category: string? — optional grouping label (e.g. 'priority', 'language', 'compliance'). Used for picker section headers when present.
_shape.system: boolean — true = Blinker-managed, false = user-created (org or agent).
_shape.created_by: string? — persona slug (manager_<org_id>_<ts>) or 'system'. Audit field.

_TODO: Replace by_org with a real `await blinkerApi.tags.list({ org_id })` endpoint per architecture/07-data-layer.md Phase 2 swap.

Document the tag-create audit trail shape — when manager+ creates a tag, the consumer (mission-control or *-portal AgentView) should write a `tag_created` activity record to canon/blinker-domain.json `activity` _payload_shapes.

Decide tag-category UX: today the picker can group by `category` for section headers, but the data may not always carry one. Consider whether un-categorized tags get a 'Other' bucket or render flat alongside categorized ones.

Sort + dedupe rules for the picker when system_tags + by_org tags overlap on `name` (case-insensitive). Today rule of precedence is: system_tags wins, by_org filtered out at picker time. Codify in the consumer's read helper.
